Definition: Kolajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kolaiah = "voice of Jehovah"; 1) father of the false prophet Ahab; 2) a Benjamite whose descendants settled in Jerusalem after the return from captivity; 3) a Levite in the time of Ezra
